entries.subject: Size: Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2005) Table 3 radius
entries.finding: Trinculo is drawn at the 9 km radius that Sheppard, Jewitt and Kleyna (2005), Table 3, estimate for S/2001 U1 from its R-band brightness with an assumed geometric albedo of 0.04; JPL's satellite discovery table identifies S/2001 U1 as Trinculo. The size rests on the assumed albedo and is not a measurement.
